sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 17582 of 2023
Applicant :- Bakhtawar Khan

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Venu Gopal,Barmeshwar Nath Tiwari,Parijat Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Venu Gopal, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamman Ram, learned Aga for
the State-respondent.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
206 of 2022, under Sections 304B, 498A IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Kotwali, District- Agra, during pendency of trial in court below.

3. F.I.R. of the present case was lodged against applicant and his other family members including the husband of the deceased and according to the F.I.R. applicant is brother-in-law (Nandoi) of the deceased and marriage of the deceased was performed with Anwar Khan on 10.2.2017 and after marriage applicant and other accused persons demanded rupees five lacs and one Wagon-R four wheeler and they also tortured her for want of dowry and on 21.5.2022 informant received a phone call that his sister has died.
4. Learned counsel for applicant submits applicant is brother-in-law (Nandoi) of the deceased and he has no concern with the family affairs of the deceased and her husband and he reside separately and he has been implicated in the present matter only to create pressure upon husband of the Bakhtawar Khan vs State Of U.P. on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20366732/
1 deceased as he is husband of his sister.
5.

entities.text: Bakhtawar Khan vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that from perusal of post-mortem report it appears that victim committed suicide.

6. Per contral, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant is brother-in-law (Nandoi) of the deceased and no specific allegation has been made against him.
7. I have learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

8. It appears that applicant is bother-in-law (Nandoi) of the deceased and no specific allegation has been made against applicant and it appears that being husband of the sister of son-in-law of the informant, he has been made accused in the present matter and in paragraph no.17 applicant specifically averred that he resides separately in his house and having no concern with the family affairs of the deceased, therefore, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9.Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.
10. Let the applicant- Bakhtawar Khan be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 19.4.2023 Kumar Manish.
